text: Modeling guidance: ideas are changes to a system; recurring practices are system state, their instances link to their context
description: From Felix's life graph, 2026-11-08 (example: Pizza backen, done often, in different contexts). Worldview: life is a system, ideas are changes to it. Guidance: a one-time change ('learn good pizza', 'make pizza weekly') is an idea and contributes to a stable need (Ernaehrung). Once established, the practice is system state, not an idea per repetition. A specific instance is an idea only when its context matters, and it links to that context ('pizza for X's birthday' -> Freundschaften), not to the practice, otherwise the practice becomes a mega-parent (which graph_hygiene flags). Use: in the idea-session prompt, in the decomposition stage and in suggestions for where a recurring item belongs.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude from the 2026-11-08 conversation.
